collections.title: Global Wastewater
collections.subtitle: Municipal wastewater shotgun metagenomes
inclusion: Eligibility tier confirmed or probable urban
Primary urban context: municipal wastewater (influent, sewage, treatment-plant samples)
At least one shotgun metagenome (WGS) run
Country validated against ISO 3166 (verified or probable)
collections.use: Resistome, pathogen and virome surveillance; cross-city comparisons of sewage communities.
collections.workflow: STRIGA Track B (sylph or MetaPhlAn 4, KMA/ResFinder), or nf-core/taxprofiler with samplesheet.csv

collections.title: Global Transit
collections.subtitle: Public transportation surface and air microbiomes
inclusion: Eligibility tier confirmed or probable urban
Primary urban context: transit (subway, metro, rail, bus surfaces and air)
collections.use: Transit microbiomes across cities (MetaSUB-like comparisons) with assay-aware analyses.
collections.workflow: Shotgun runs: STRIGA Track B; amplicon runs: DADA2 or QIIME 2

collections.title: Urban Air
collections.subtitle: Air, aerosols and settled dust
inclusion: Eligibility tier confirmed or probable urban
Primary urban context: air and dust (aerosols, particulate matter, settled dust)
collections.use: Airborne microbial exposure, seasonality and pollution associations.
collections.workflow: Low-biomass samples: check negative controls in the source studies before pooling

collections.title: Urban Greenspace
collections.subtitle: Urban soil, parks and vegetation
inclusion: Eligibility tier confirmed or probable urban
Primary urban context: soil and greenspace (parks, lawns, street trees, urban soil)
collections.use: Homogenization of urban soils; comparisons with non-urban soils from the same regions.
collections.workflow: 16S/ITS runs: DADA2; shotgun runs: STRIGA Track B

collections.title: Urban Virome
collections.subtitle: Viral RNA and metatranscriptomics candidates
inclusion: Eligibility tier confirmed or probable urban
At least one Viral RNA or metatranscriptomic run
collections.use: RNA virus discovery and viral persistence; includes targeted SARS-CoV-2 runs, so check library strategy.
collections.workflow: Assembly + geNomad (STRIGA --viral) or targeted variant pipelines

collections.title: Urban Resistome
collections.subtitle: Shotgun metagenomes from every urban habitat
inclusion: Eligibility tier confirmed or probable urban
At least one shotgun metagenome (WGS) run
Place validated against GeoNames (verified or probable)
collections.use: Antimicrobial resistance across connected urban habitats (UMDB-AMR).
collections.workflow: STRIGA Track B with --amr (KMA against ResFinder)
